name: Presbytère de Saint-Germain-des-Prés
note: The low stone annex on the Place Saint-Germain-des-Prés, in front of the tower (aerial; a Haussmann block with shopfronts until now).

name: Notre-Dame-du-Liban
note: The Jesuits' chapel of 1894, hemmed in between the Foyer franco-libanais and the Institut Curie: a Gothic nave with its apse to the north-east and no tower. The kit's tower stood through the neighbours' roofs (owner, 2026-10-31).

name: La couverture des voies d'Austerlitz
note: The slabs across the track bed at Paris Rive Gauche, and the open cuts between them (owner, 2026-10-31): traced from the aerial, u and v in the builder. Base at the cut's floor.

name: Le terre-plein du Pont Neuf
note: The platform Henri IV stands on, level with the bridge, its stone walls down to the Vert-Galant and its stairs (owner, 2026-10-31; aerial). The bake levels the ground and clears OSM's steps: regions.json levelGrounds and flatStreets.

name: Hommage à Charlie Parker
note: Kirili's five pink-stone blocks in a ring (2006), each 2.5 m, a rough lower half and a cut geometric top (owner, 2026-11-03; fr.wikipedia): bugs/artworks.ts.

name: Vasque Paris 2024
note: The 7 m flame ring under its 22 m balloon on the Grand Bassin Rond of the Tuileries, drawn grounded as by day (owner, 2026-11-03; fr.wikipedia): bugs/artworks.ts.

name: Monument commémoratif de la campagne de Tunisie 1942-1943
note: Three closed granite books, gilt-edged, stacked on a stepped plinth, the map plaque on the great book's top (owner's Commons photograph, 2015-12-13; 2026-11-03): bugs/artworks.ts. Long axis east–west; lat/lon/size from OSM way 427592604's box (historic=memorial, not a building, so never in the bake).

name: Chronos 10
note: Schöffer's kinetic tower (1978) in the Jardin Tino-Rossi: white drum, polished band, a steel cage with arms carrying mirror discs (owner's photograph, 2026-11-03): bugs/artworks.ts.

name: Mind Accumulation
note: Micha Laury's piece (1988) in the Jardin Tino-Rossi: the polished oval drum on its side, a pipe snaking across the lawn, raised pipe loops on sawhorses ending at a steel cone (owner's photograph, 2026-11-03): bugs/artworks.ts. Layout by eye.

name: Tierra de México en tierra de Francia
note: Águeda Lozano's two polished steel sheets (given by Mexico, 2006) on the island of the Place de Mexico: the gashed inner cylinder and the outer sheet wrapping it (owner's photograph, 2026-11-03): bugs/artworks.ts. Not in OSM; placed at the centre of the place's ring.

name: Interpénétration des deux espaces
note: Rougemont's painted columns and drums (1975) on their slab in the Jardin Tino-Rossi (owner's photograph, 2026-11-03): bugs/artworks.ts. Bands by eye; the slab's long axis east–west is a guess.

name: Le Globe symbolique
note: Erik Reitzel's lattice sphere (1995) on the lawn before UNESCO, ~10 m of meridians and parallels in thin tube (owner's photograph, 2026-11-03): bugs/artworks.ts.

name: Les Sphérades (ouest)
note: Pol Bury's twelve polished steel spheres (1985), one size, on stems on an octagonal table that spills into the basin, in the Galerie d'Orléans' court, Palais-Royal (owner's photograph, 2026-11-03): bugs/artworks.ts; the falling sheet is in paris-fountains.json. Placed on OSM ways 440281436 / 440281437 (centre, size, turn measured with osmium).

name: Les Sphérades (est)
note: Pol Bury's twelve polished steel spheres (1985), one size, on stems on an octagonal table that spills into the basin, in the Galerie d'Orléans' court, Palais-Royal (owner's photograph, 2026-11-03): bugs/artworks.ts; the falling sheet is in paris-fountains.json. Placed on OSM ways 440281436 / 440281437 (centre, size, turn measured with osmium).

name: Place Igor-Stravinsky: pipes, glass roof and murals
note: The IRCAM's eight white ventilation pipes (OSM 202498507…514, dropped by the bake as unnamed chimneys), the glass roof over its studios with its railing (OSM 227834262, dropped as a canopy), and the murals on the blind walls on the square's west side: Jef Aérosol's Chuuuttt!, Shepard Fairey's Knowledge+Action=Power, Invader (owner's Street View, 2026-11-03): bugs/stravinsky-square.ts. North-up frame from 48.8594 2.3512.

name: Immeuble Fulton
note: Bernard Bühler's social housing at 11 quai d'Austerlitz / 2 rue Fulton (2017): a four-storey concrete base on OSM's outline and two eleven-floor towers hung with staggered yellow-to-green glass balcony boxes (owner's Street View, 2026-11-03; ArchDaily): bugs/fulton.ts. North-up frame from 48.8381 2.3720; the box placement is a fixed scatter, not surveyed.
